suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as phenotype specific temporal risk. Apply only to recurrent post-traumatic epilepsy/seizure disorder after documented penetrating traumatic brain injury; do not map a single provoked seizure. Human longitudinal combat-head-injury evidence supports persistent post-traumatic epilepsy risk decades after mostly penetrating injuries; individual attribution still requires clinical assessment. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Documentation that Penetrating Head Trauma matches the source-specific phenotype or population
Independent diagnosis of Seizure Disorder / Epilepsy with compatible chronology
Assessment of competing medical, treatment-related, behavioral, and demographic contributors
Qualified clinical opinion before applying the population-level relationship to an individual case
